forkChangesPreserved: Queue-aware attachment and composer dispatch progress, including attachment previews, dispatch status labels, minimum send-indicator timing, retry awareness, delivery state, and active-thread busy state.
T3 Pretty's model identity caption and detailed model identity construction in the chat composer.
The Reduce Transparency accessibility behavior, which renders an opaque light or dark composer plate instead of live-sampling glass.
Composer animation safeguards: layout morphing can be disabled while the editor is focused, and the existing Android keyboard-synchronized transition behavior remains intact.
T3 Pretty's light/dark composer fallback colors, borders, shape, and shadow presentation.
T3 Pretty's collapsed thread model identity caption, including model/provider/option details below the composer.
The iOS native model and reasoning settings menu, including haptics and keyboard-preserving everyday adjustments.
Kimi provider handoff behavior that normalizes the fork-only yolo mode when selecting a model from another provider; this now applies through both the native menu and upstream settings route.
T3 Pretty's provider-aware settings summary and model identity construction.
T3 Pretty's centralized composer surface/editor styles, themed editor text style, and conditional layout animation.
T3 Pretty's expanded toolbar placement outside the composer surface, its spacing, and its entry/exit animations.
upstreamChangesIntegrated: The parent GlassSurface abstraction replaces direct LiquidGlassView feature detection for the normal composer surface.
The parent composer surface is treated as passive glass containing interactive child controls, with transparent tint and the shared unsupported-platform fallback styling.
The parent's route-based existing-thread settings presentation, route session type, and navigation transition typing are integrated.
The parent's existing-thread pill/card morph semantics are retained and documented alongside the fork's animation exception.
Upstream's environment-and-thread-scoped ExistingThreadSettingsRouteSession and route presentation architecture.

Upstream's navigation-backed ThreadSettingsSheet lifecycle, including active-session refresh, owner cleanup, stack navigation, and transition-based keyboard restoration already surrounding this conflict.
Upstream's removal of the obsolete locally rendered ThreadSettingsSheet instance.
Upstream settings-route model, provider-option, and runtime updates, adapted so model changes retain Pretty's provider-mode normalization.
Pretty's caption fallback now presents the upstream settings session before opening its navigation-backed sheet.

upstreamChangesOmitted.change: Removal of the activeThreadBusy composer prop.
upstreamChangesOmitted.reason: T3 Pretty's send-progress and retry safeguards still require the active-thread busy signal together with queue-head, retry, and delivery state; deleting it would regress fork-specific composer dispatch behavior.

upstreamChangesOmitted.change: Using GlassSurface while T3 Pretty's Reduce Transparency preference is enabled.
upstreamChangesOmitted.reason: The fork requires a guaranteed opaque plate in this accessibility mode, so only that conditional path bypasses glass; the parent GlassSurface is used for all normal rendering.

upstreamChangesOmitted.change: The upstream inline ComposerSurface style hunk, including the expanded 26-point radius, 140-point minimum height, asymmetric padding, and inline collapsed pill styling.
upstreamChangesOmitted.reason: Those visual dimensions and inline styling would replace T3 Pretty's authoritative centralized composer design and conditional layout-animation behavior.

upstreamChangesOmitted.change: The upstream inline ComposerEditor geometry and text-style hunk, including the expanded 72-point minimum height.
upstreamChangesOmitted.reason: T3 Pretty's centralized editor styles and themed editorTextStyle are authoritative and may encode fork-specific layout and performance behavior.

upstreamChangesOmitted.change: Moving the expanded toolbar inside ComposerSurface with 4 points of top padding, no bottom padding, and no Animated.View transition wrapper.
